notes.body: A hollow bolster of woven bamboo, leaned against for coolness in summer heat.
A mu is a Chinese measure of field area. Three hundred mu means a large landed estate.
notes.span: three hundred mu of fields by the city wall

notes.body: A sun is a traditional unit of length, about three centimetres. Three sun is roughly nine centimetres long.
The Congling, the Onion Range, is the mountains west of China. To come from beyond them is to come from Central Asia, far outside China.
An obscure ailment of the private parts. The original names it without explaining it.
A well-known Chinese anecdote: the general Cao Cao, on a thirsty march, told his men a plum grove lay ahead, and the thought of sour plums made their mouths water.
notes.span: there was a plum grove ahead

notes.body: The word appears in English in the original. It points to the habit of Chinese popular novels of closing with an explicit moral.

data.say: Kept notes sparse to measures, place-names, ailments and allusions the sentence cannot give, leaving the moral suspension unexplained.
